before.middleware_stack_effect: Multiple middleware/dependency validations could update and commit the same auth_sessions row during one logical page/API request.

after.middleware_stack_effect: Middleware validation uses managed_read_session and queues last_seen in memory without synchronous DB writes.
after.batch_effect: At most one auth_sessions.last_seen_at update per session per 60 second defer window, written during periodic/background flush.

expected_result: Read-heavy authenticated traffic no longer contends on auth_sessions.last_seen_at for every request.
login and /auth/me are not blocked by synchronous last_seen writes on the request path.
auth/session table write pressure is reduced to occasional batch updates.
